description: This file defines an interface IProductRepository for data access operations related to 'Product' entities, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting products.

classes.name: IProductRepository
classes.description: An interface providing asynchronous methods for CRUD operations on 'Product' entities, abstracting data access logic.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing product by ID asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID asynchronously.
